facts.fact: Yes: the National Creche Scheme for children of working mothers runs as Palna, a component of Mission Shakti (Ministry of Women and Child Development)
facts.quote: The National Creche Scheme for children of working mothers will run as the component named Palna under Mission Shakti.

facts.fact: Palna provides day-care creche facilities for the children of working mothers
facts.quote: Considering the difficulties faced by the working mothers in giving due child care and protection to their children, it has been decided to provide the day-care créche facilities through the component of Palna.

facts.fact: Palna is for children aged 6 months to 6 years
facts.quote: What is the target group and beneficiaries on which the scheme focuses? The scheme focuses on children of 6 months to 6 years.

behaviour: Names the Palna scheme (creches under Mission Shakti, Ministry of Women and Child Development) and cites wcd.gov.in.
fail_if: Names no official creche scheme, invents a scheme, or cites no official source.
summary: Added from WCD: Palna = National Creche Scheme for working mothers under Mission Shakti; day-care creches; children 6 months to 6 years.
